name: Deserts
description: Deserts word search puzzles open onto arid-land English — dune, oasis, cactus, mesa, canyon, mirage and twilight — for adults who like wide-horizon geography. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No timer, no account and no resort brands: just calm landscape words. Neighbors include Mountains, Canyons via National Parks, Geology and Beach for contrasting shores. Prefer bigger letters? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then choose a difficulty as gentle as dawn shade.
